newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar edges into plus column by close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar edges into plus column by close.

text.p: LIFFE front month white sugar erased its losses on Thursday in last-minute deals before the close.
August, which had slumped along with New York, was hovering about $1.30 down until the close when it snapped up to finish 10 cents firmer at $310.50 per tonne.
The front month had had earlier crept up from its low of $308.30 on producer buy-backs, traders said. It was the most active contract, accounting for 1,472 of the 1,894 lots traded.
October finished 30 cents stronger at $300.70 after dipping to $299.90.
In Paris, August ended down 40 cents at $311.70 and October down 50 cents at $304.50.
